name: obs-triton-trtllm-backend-metrics
notes: The Triton Metrics section: TRT-LLM's LLM-specific metrics are registered into the Triton endpoint as a small number of label-switched gauges - nv_trt_llm_request_metrics{request_type="waiting|context|scheduled|max|active"}, nv_trt_llm_kv_cache_block_metrics{kv_cache_block_type="fraction|tokens_per|used|free|max"}, nv_trt_llm_general_metrics, nv_trt_llm_disaggregated_serving_metrics. Only available from Triton 23.11+.
